messages.text:
The shop’s records show that the cordless screwdriver was received back, and the refundable amount is BRL 150.00 (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/amount).

We can’t send the refund to a new card; it can only go to the original payment. If the old card was cancelled, its issuer handles any credit, and the shop can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Would you like me to create a proposal for BRL 150.00 to the original payment?
